About the photos

The people in flok are invented. The photos are real: ordinary pictures that real people posted to Wikimedia Commons under open licenses. Each one is something its poster would actually take: their plant, their bread, their walk, their nightstand. They are cropped to fit the feed. Nothing else is changed. One post is a screenshot of flok itself, made in the studio.
